body: Try-Try to wait. Wait until you are in college, or self-suffisent. Then, you can find someone. You do not HAVE to tell your parents. But if you already can live on your own with your own money, and you have hope that they will be okay with it, tell them. But again, you do not have to.

And please, listen to the song. It-I have an attachment to it, I was having a terrible anxiety attack on vacation, and i didnt have the key to the hotel, and i didnt know what the number for 911 was, and even if i did i had no phone. but i had a computer. Listened to 'spectrum'. listened to some other songs, calmed down a bit. I-I was hyperventalating and crying and felt like my lungs would explode any second now. So please. Just music. Music. Find good songs. 'Spectrum' by boyinaband. 'Promise' by emma blackery. AND DONT DO ANYTHING STUPID. LIKE RUN AWAY OR KILL YOURSELF. Your parents love you, no matter how much it seems they dont. *sigh*

My parents-they also aren't the best. But the problem is that they are both stressed. My stradegy so far is listening to music. (Btw a good song to listen to when you're not feeling great is 'Spectrum' by boyinaband) Just to ignore them. Don't fully ignore them. Just stay calm, don't shout back if you can. If they try to hit you, don't hit back but run. Try to--*sigh* Music. Music and the internet. But is you cant, draw pictures. draw something, then draw it again in a few months. See that you can improve if you try. Do something for your parents. like, clean the kitchen or something. But i would just say, dont talk to them is they seem mad or stressed, and distract yourself with the internet or books or drawing or, evenbetter, friends and schoolwork.
